Proposed slots (all PST):
- Tue 5/5 09:30–10:00 (20–30 min quick integration + Q&A)
- Tue 5/5 10:30–11:15 (45 min deep dive + sandbox run)
- Wed 5/6 09:00–10:00 (60 min full walkthrough and perf talk)

If any of those work reply with the preferred slot and which agenda you want (quick proof-of-concept vs. full integration review). If none work, tell me two alternatives and I'll send an invite.

Prework we recommend (short):
- Create a free sandbox API key (if you want live testing)
- Share one example prompt and an example dataset shape (if applicable)

I've attached a short quickstart guide to get an API key and one-line curl examples. Calendar link for other slots: https://cal.redwood.com/lauren/slots?token=xyz123

Best,
